name: Monthly Refrigerator and Freezer Maintenance Form

sections.name: Visit preparation and common safety checks

tasks.description: Confirm asset ID or QR, location, make, model and serial number
Ask operator about faults, alarms, trips, leaks or performance changes since last visit
Confirm safe isolation and required shutdown before opening or cleaning service areas
Inspect plug, cable, isolator, guards, covers, feet, castors and accessible connections
Check for unusual noise, vibration, odour, overheating, corrosion, leakage or loose parts
Function test through a representative operating cycle without bypassing safety devices
Record required measurements with instrument ID and before and after values
Photograph exceptions and completed work; create a finding for every exception
Return equipment to a known safe operating condition and confirm with site representative

sections.name: Refrigerator and Freezer monthly tasks

tasks.description: Compare cabinet display with calibrated probe reading; record ambient and internal temperature
Inspect door gasket, hinges, closer, latch and heater where fitted
Check condenser cleanliness and unrestricted inlet and discharge airflow
Inspect evaporator airflow and frost or ice pattern without damaging fins
Check fans for correct operation, noise and rubbing
Inspect condensate pan and drain for blockage, standing water or leakage
Look for oil staining, pipe rubbing, damaged insulation and corrosion
Check internal light, alarm and defrost indication where fitted
Confirm setpoint has not been changed without customer approval
